decisions.title: WJ01 parse raw JSON to unknown
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, parse raw JSON into unknown before any domain read.
decisions.falsifier: A raw JSON.parse result reaches userService domain fields unchecked.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every JSON boundary in external repos is safe.

decisions.title: WJ02 create user parser boundary
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, keep create-user input parsing local and narrow before persistence behavior.
decisions.falsifier: createUserFromJson reads email or role from an unchecked record.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove the parser is reusable across all target services.

decisions.title: WJ03 discriminated create-user result
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, represent create-user success and invalid input through a discriminated union.
decisions.falsifier: Callers infer failure from null, false, or thrown shape instead of result.kind.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every domain action needs this exact union shape.

decisions.title: WJ04 invalid JSON behavior proof
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, malformed JSON must return invalid_input invalid_json and have a focused test.
decisions.falsifier: Malformed JSON throws through the command path or lacks a test.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all invalid inputs are exhaustively covered.

decisions.title: WJ05 invalid shape behavior proof
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, missing email and invalid role must return invalid_shape with tests.
decisions.falsifier: Missing email or owner role passes into a CreatedUser.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove production email validation quality.

decisions.title: WJ06 default role env parser
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, DEFAULT_ROLE must be narrowed to admin or member before becoming RuntimeConfig.
decisions.falsifier: An arbitrary DEFAULT_ROLE string becomes a user role.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every environment variable has a parser.

decisions.title: WJ07 target owner files
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, plan from AGENTS, repair-contract, src, and tests owner files only.
decisions.falsifier: Planning uses parent KRN package source as target truth.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove owner-file recall for arbitrary repos.

decisions.title: WJ08 surgical repair scope
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, touch config, userService, and tests only unless a focused proof requires more.
decisions.falsifier: A JSON-boundary repair also rewrites package layout or unrelated modules.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove future target repairs are always three-file changes.

decisions.title: WJ09 no network validator
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, do not add network calls or external validation services.
decisions.falsifier: The repair depends on a remote validation call.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all target repos are offline-only.

decisions.title: WJ10 reproducible weak scenario
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, use the scenario materializer when a weak baseline is required.
decisions.falsifier: A trial depends on git history to recreate the weak baseline.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove the scenario covers every weakness class.

decisions.title: WJ11 target proof non-proof
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, report that pnpm test proves fixture behavior only, not product readiness.
decisions.falsifier: Passing fixture tests are described as real target transfer or product readiness.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove KRN product readiness.

decisions.title: WJ12 package test proof
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript, the verification command is the target package test, not parent workspace mutation.
decisions.falsifier: The dry run edits parent package state to make the target pass.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove integrated monorepo CI behavior.

decisions.title: WJ13 reuse unknown-first TypeScript pattern
decisions.statement: Reuse KRN TypeScript practice: external input stays unknown until a narrow parser proves shape.
decisions.falsifier: The target-specific repair uses casts instead of narrowing.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every KRN internal standard transfers unchanged.

decisions.title: WJ14 reuse finite result state
decisions.statement: Reuse finite result-state practice for user creation instead of null or boolean failures.
decisions.falsifier: The target returns CreatedUser or null after repair.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove all target APIs need discriminated unions.

decisions.title: WJ15 reuse focused invalid input tests
decisions.statement: Reuse focused invalid-input test practice before claiming the boundary is repaired.
decisions.falsifier: The repair has only happy-path tests.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove broad target quality.

decisions.title: WJ stale any JSON parse
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript WJ01 WJ02, JSON.parse can return any and domain code can trust it.
decisions.falsifier: The current fixture parses to unknown and narrows.
decisions.doesNotProve: Historical weak baseline only.

decisions.title: WJ stale null result
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript WJ03, CreatedUser or null is enough for failure state.
decisions.falsifier: The current fixture returns CreateUserResult with kind.
decisions.doesNotProve: Historical weak baseline only.

decisions.title: WJ stale trust env role
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript WJ06, DEFAULT_ROLE can be trusted as a domain role string.
decisions.falsifier: parseUserRole rejects non-admin/member role values.
decisions.doesNotProve: Historical weak baseline only.

decisions.title: WJ stale framework rewrite
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript WJ08 WJ09, migrate framework or add validation service to fix JSON.
decisions.falsifier: The repair contract forbids framework migration and network validators.
decisions.doesNotProve: Historical rejected direction only.

decisions.title: WJ stale git history baseline
decisions.statement: For weak-json-boundary-typescript WJ10, rely on git history to recreate the weak baseline.
decisions.falsifier: The scenario materializer exists for a replayable weak baseline.
decisions.doesNotProve: Historical process limitation only.

decisions.title: WJ reject dashboard for target
decisions.statement: Build a dashboard or API surface before repairing weak-json-boundary-typescript.
decisions.falsifier: The target repair needs only src/tests/docs files.
decisions.doesNotProve: Rejected path only.

decisions.title: WJ reject network validator
decisions.statement: Call a remote validator to decide whether weak-json-boundary-typescript input is valid.
decisions.falsifier: The target forbids network calls.
decisions.doesNotProve: Rejected path only.

decisions.title: WJ reject parent kernel edit
decisions.statement: Edit parent KRN packages to make weak-json-boundary-typescript planning look successful.
decisions.falsifier: Allowed writes exclude parent KRN package source.
decisions.doesNotProve: Rejected path only.

decisions.title: WJ reject delete tests
decisions.statement: Delete weak-json-boundary-typescript invalid-input tests to reduce review burden.
decisions.falsifier: Invalid JSON and invalid shape tests are required behavior proof.
decisions.doesNotProve: Rejected path only.

decisions.title: WJ reject live Codex proof
decisions.statement: Require live Codex execution before a weak-json-boundary-typescript packet quality eval can run.
decisions.falsifier: This eval is deterministic packet quality, not live execution.
decisions.doesNotProve: Rejected path only.
